misses: Written by John Howard Lawson, the film is about a notorious French jewel thief hiding in the labyrinthine native quarter of Algiers known as the Casbah.
The Walter Wanger production was a remake of the successful 1937 French film "Pépé le Moko", which derived its plot from the Henri La Barthe novel of the same name.
"Algiers" was a sensation because it was the first Hollywood film starring Hedy Lamarr, whose beauty became the main attraction for film audiences.
